description: This file defines classes, functions, and constants related to engine control in an automotive firmware project, including fuel scheduling, sensor states, engine state management, and knock detection.

classes.name: MockAdcState
classes.description: Manages mock ADC states for testing, including setting mock voltages and retrieving ADC values.

classes.name: FuelSchedule
classes.description: Handles fuel injection event scheduling for engine cycles.

classes.name: ThermistorMath
classes.description: Performs thermistor temperature calculations based on resistance and configuration.

classes.name: SensorsState
classes.description: Stores sensor readings such as temperature, oil pressure, accelerometer data, and fuel gauge.

classes.name: FuelConsumptionState
classes.description: Tracks fuel consumption metrics over time.

classes.name: WarningCodeState
classes.description: Manages warning codes and warning state.

classes.name: EngineState
classes.description: Maintains engine operational data, including timing, knock detection, and sensor states.

classes.name: FsioState
classes.description: Stores Fuel System I/O state and related control flags.

classes.name: StartupFuelPumping
classes.description: Manages startup fuel pumping logic based on TPS input.

methods.name: setMockVoltage
methods.description: Sets a mock voltage for a specific hardware channel.

methods.name: getMockAdcValue
methods.description: Retrieves the mock ADC value for a specific hardware channel.

methods.name: addFuelEvents
methods.description: Schedules all fuel events for an engine cycle.

methods.name: addFuelEventsForCylinder
methods.description: Schedules fuel events for a specific cylinder.

methods.name: prepareThermistorCurve
methods.description: Prepares thermistor curve data based on configuration.

methods.name: getKelvinTemperatureByResistance
methods.description: Calculates temperature in Kelvin from resistance.

methods.name: addData
methods.description: Adds fuel consumption data based on duration.

methods.name: addWarningCode
methods.description: Adds a warning code to the warning state.

methods.name: isWarningNow
methods.description: Checks if a warning is active at the current time.
